items.title: Spain starts evacuating virus-hit cruise ship in Tenerife
items.description: Spanish passengers are the first to leave the MV Hondius, after an outbreak saw three people die and several infected.

items.title: Putin says he thinks Ukraine conflict 'coming to an end'
items.description: The Russian leader sees potential for Ukraine negotiations, but condemns the West's backing for President Zelensky.

items.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
items.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

items.title: Australia's right-wing One Nation party scores historic parliamentary win
items.description: One Nation gains its first seat in the lower house, in a by-election seen as a key test for the populist party.

items.title: Buddhist monk arrested over alleged rape of teen in Sri Lanka
items.description: The Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero holds one of the most revered positions in the Buddhist world.

items.title: Suspected boat explosion injures 11 in Miami
items.description: Officials are investigating what caused the explosion at a popular marina in southern Florida.

items.title: I will serve - not rule over Hungary, says new PM
items.description: Nearly a month ago Péter Magyar steered his Tisza party to a landslide victory, sweeping away 16 years of rule by Viktor Orbán.

items.title: Iran demands guarantees for World Cup participation
items.description: The Iranian Football Federation (FFIRI) has presented Fifa with 10 conditions for participation at the World Cup in the US, Mexico and Canada.

items.title: Greece conducts controlled blast of mystery naval drone explosives
items.description: The unmanned vessel, suspected to be of Ukrainian origin, was found by fishermen in a cave on Thursday.

items.title: Mexican parents criticise ending school year a month early for World Cup
items.description: The federal government faces widespread anger for saying the school year could end on 5 June to accommodate the football tournament.

items.title: Person killed after being hit by plane on runway at Denver airport
items.description: The unidentified individual had jumped a perimeter fence two minutes before being struck by the airliner.

items.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
items.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.
